funnyport.rule.funnyWarp.desc: Port of 20w14infinite: enables /funnywarp to the built-in funny dimensions
funnyport.rule.funnyBookPortals.desc: Port of 20w14infinite book portals: writing a funny word (e.g. 'creeper') on any page of a book & quill and right-clicking teleports you to that dimension
funnyport.rule.throwableBlocks.desc: Port of 22w13oneBlockAtATime: sneak + right-click throws the block you are holding
funnyport.rule.blockGrabbing.desc: Port of 22w13oneBlockAtATime: sneak + left-click with empty hands picks the targeted block into your hand (true = even unbreakable blocks like bedrock)
funnyport.rule.feedingFrenzy.desc: Port of Minecraft 2.0: any food item counts as breeding food for animals
funnyport.rule.redstoneBugs.desc: Port of Minecraft 2.0 redstone bugs: placing redstone dust has a chance to spawn a 'redstone bug' silverfish
funnyport.rule.loveAndHugs.desc: Port of 15w14a Love and Hugs: monsters stop targeting players
funnyport.rule.potatoOfDoom.desc: Port of 24w14potato: eating a poisonous potato triggers random potato doom
